# opnsense_acmeclient_validation (Data Source)

Retrieves an ACME Client validation method from the OPNsense os-acme-client plugin by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_acmeclient_validation" "example" {
  id = "<uuid>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the validation method.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description for this validation method.
- `dns_cf_account_id` (String) Optional Cloudflare account ID.
- `dns_cf_email` (String) Cloudflare account email (Global API Key auth).
- `dns_cf_key` (String, Sensitive) Cloudflare Global API Key.
- `dns_cf_token` (String, Sensitive) Cloudflare API token.
- `dns_cf_zone_id` (String) Optional Cloudflare zone ID to limit token scope.
- `dns_service` (String) DNS-01 provider identifier.
- `dns_sleep` (String) Seconds to wait after publishing DNS records before validation.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this validation method is enabled.
- `method` (String) Challenge type.
- `name` (String) Display name for the validation method.
